plans.objective: [DIM: NEW] 解空间刚性由代数约束结构决定，线性约束导致刚性（唯一解），高维多项式约束导致胖（连续解族）

steps.description: Create the Python script for the solution space rigidity experiment. The script will implement two constraint classes (LinearRigidConstraint for low-dimensional unique solutions and PolynomialFatConstraint for high-dimensional continuous solutions), train small feedforward networks using scipy.optimize.minimize with L-BFGS-B, and compute N_c(w) for w in {5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30} with multi-seed optimization to determine if N_c(w) is non-increasing (supporting rigidity) or increasing (supporting fat solution spaces).
